construction: Composited deterministically from one PixelLab pixen candidate (16x16 cap+band unit, seed 11), not generated at 96x16 directly — PixelLab's pixen tool refuses a non-square canvas when either side is below 32px. Left cap = cols 2-7 of the source unit (6px), band = cols 8-10 of the source unit (3px, tiled 28x), right cap = horizontal mirror of the left cap. Colors snapped to the ART-13/PIXELLAB_UI_PRODUCTION_PLAN CHASSIS ramp (#0F0D0B/#33291F/#4A3B2B/#6B5A3E/#7C6A4A) via reduce_colors.
integrationNote: The generated pill shape is only 8px tall (rows 4-11) inside the 16px canvas, tapering at rows 4 and 11 and flat/rectangular at rows 5-10. The Flutter-drawn HP fill should be inset within rows 5-10 (the flat straight section) and within roughly cols 7-88 (inside both end caps), not the full 16px height or full 96px width.
